source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 7ης Ιουνίου — «Άγιοι Βασιλείδης μάρτυρας Στρατιώτης και Ιωάννης ο οσιομάρτυρας»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 7 Ιουνίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, and carries both men on one page with a head line for each, «Αγιος Βασιλειδης Μαρτυρας Στρατιωτης» and «Αγιος Ιωαννης ο Οσιομαρτυρας». Its whole entry is the sentence «Δεν έχουμε λεπτομέρειες για τον βίο των Αγίων» — we have no details of the saints' lives. That is a want of knowledge and not saint.gr's asterisked refusal to vouch for an entry; the page carries no asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence. The ranks are the only thing the day's line gives, and they differ between the two men: Basilides is «μάρτυρας Στρατιώτης» and John «ο οσιομάρτυρας». The day's listing carries a second pair on the same day of whom one is also called John — «Άγιοι Ταράσιος και Ιωάννης» (`/499/`) — and the two Johns are two men on two pages with two different ranks. Neither man is any of the corpus's existing Basilides — the companion of Bassus or the one of the ten of Crete. There is no year, so no `dates` object, and no hymn is printed.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue on pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (30 September 2026).
